app.title: giz Studio
project.none: Open a project folder to start.
check.title: Check
check.ok: All good: no errors, no warnings.
errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.busy: A video is already being rendered.
errors.noVault: This system offers no vault to keep the key safely.
errors.untrustedSender: request refused: it did not come from the Studio window
errors.folderNotGranted: This folder was not opened by the Studio: {folder}
errors.vaultUnreadable: Could not read the saved keys ({file}).
errors.noKeyCheck: There is no test for this key yet: it will be used when the Studio makes images or voices.
errors.noKey: No key saved for this service.
keys.hint: add the key in Settings → AI accounts
wizard.title: Let's set up your Studio
wizard.subtitle: Six quick steps. You can change everything later in Settings.
language.intro: Which language do you want the Studio in? Your videos can be in Portuguese or English either way.
projects.intro: Each video is a folder with its script, cast, voices and final video. They all live together in one folder.
gpu.intro: Voices are made on your computer. With an NVIDIA card they come out much faster.
gpu.none: No NVIDIA card found. That's fine: the voice runs on the processor, it just takes longer.
gpu.unsupported: Graphics card support exists for Linux for now (WSL included). Here the voice runs on the processor.
gpu.installSize: Downloads about {size} of NVIDIA libraries, no administrator password needed.
gpu.ready: The card is ready to make voices.
task.stopped: paused, picks up where it stopped
models.intro: The voice uses Qwen3-TTS, an open model that runs on your computer. It is downloaded only once.
models.largeDetail: More natural voice that follows style hints (“sound excited”).
models.whisperDetail: Optional: checks how each line is pronounced and times the captions.
accounts.intro: Optional. With an AI account the Studio writes scripts, paints scenarios and uses studio voices. Without one, you write the script and the voice comes from your computer.
accounts.noKeychain: This system has no keychain available. Keys are kept in {folder}, in files only your user can read (the same place the giz command uses).
accounts.cost: Each test makes one tiny call to the service (a fraction of a cent).
license.intro: giz draws the videos with Remotion. The Remotion license is free for individuals and for companies of up to 3 people. Larger companies need to buy a license at remotion.pro.
license.empresa-ate-3: A company of up to 3 people
license.empresa-com-licenca: A larger company, with a Remotion license
license.paid: Got it: the company license covers it.
license.later: That's fine. Remember to check the license before using it in a larger company.
settings.title: Settings
projects.ready: Folder ready: new projects go there.
